pages.text: The lake froze solid. Grandpa tapped the ice and nodded.
Nils wanted to catch a fish through the ice. He liked his summer spot. "I'll fish there!"
Grandpa made two holes, one near shore and one in the lake center.
Grandpa pointed to the middle hole. "Deeper here." Nils sat down by the shore hole.
Nils lowered his line. It hung loose and still.
Fish splashed in Grandpa's bucket. Nils's bucket was empty.
His hands were icy cold. Looking in his hole, he could see bottom stones in the shallow water.
Grandpa said, "Shallow water gets cold right to the bottom. Fish go down to deeper, less cold water."
Nils moved to the middle hole. As soon as the line went down, tug, tug! It moved!
Up! Nils pulled the line. A palm-sized fish flapped on the ice. Steam drifted from the hole.
